checked_claims.claim: Setup specifies the board and lap count, player components, board-specific Heat and Stress quantities, deck composition, Engine Heat, starting gear, Stress reserve, randomized grid order, and opening hand; optional handicap is included.
The round has mandatory simultaneous gear and card steps, followed by sequential steps from the frontmost car; gear determines the number of cards and shifting two positions costs one Heat.
checked_claims.result: Accurate. The snapshot correctly explains the Race Line tiebreak for cars side by side.

checked_claims.claim: Movement uses the total value of played cards, moves that exact number of spaces, and uses the closest-to-Race-Line spot when available; cars do not block passage, but a full destination sends the moving car to the first free space behind the blockers.
checked_claims.result: Accurate. The summary's no-voluntary-short-move statement follows the exact-movement rule.

checked_claims.claim: Played Stress cards are replaced by Speed cards revealed from the draw deck, with non-Speed cards discarded; all Stress resolution occurs before Adrenaline.
Adrenaline applies to the last car, or the last two when at least five cars started; it provides one extra speed and one extra Cooldown for React, and cannot be saved.
checked_claims.result: Accurate, including the starting-car-count condition used after finishers leave.

checked_claims.claim: React permits available Cooldown and Boost in any order; Cooldown returns Heat from hand to Engine, and Boost costs Engine Heat, reveals until a Speed card, and adds its speed for corner checks.
checked_claims.result: Accurate. The snapshot also correctly notes Cooldown values for first and second gear and the possibility of cooling Heat before spending it to Boost.

checked_claims.claim: Slipstream is optional after ending next to or behind a car, moves two spaces, does not add to corner-check speed, and final-lap finish-line restrictions are stated.
checked_claims.result: Accurate; the snapshot appropriately applies the corner check to Corner Lines crossed during Slipstream movement, consistent with the corner-check trigger.

checked_claims.claim: Each Corner Line crossed triggers a separate check in crossing order; excess over each Speed Limit costs that much Heat, and insufficient Heat causes a spin out with the stated movement, Stress, and gear consequences.

Discarding is optional, Heat and Stress cannot normally be discarded from hand, discard piles cannot be browsed, and replenishing moves Play Area cards to discard before drawing only to seven; empty decks recycle the discard pile without Play Area cards.
checked_claims.result: Accurate, including the forced Heat-card handling for Cluttered Hand described as an exception.

checked_claims.claim: Cluttered Hand forces playable cards plus Heat to fill the required slots, zero movement, a shift to first gear, discard of committed cards, and skipping to Replenish Hand.
checked_claims.result: Accurate; the stated React and Boost omission follows from skipping directly to step 9.

checked_claims.claim: Final-lap scoring, same-round finish tie-breaking, post-finish corner-limit handling, Hall of Fame placement, and Adrenaline based on the number of cars that started are covered.
Track-line meanings distinguish the core Corner Line trigger from the Legends Line used only in advanced play.
checked_claims.result: Accurate; the booklet labels the Legends Line as advanced-play only and identifies crossing a Corner Line as the core corner-check trigger.
